# Day-one page: Plantpal (synthetic fixture, R107 style)

The first five things the owner does on day one, each with a check that it works. Invented for tests.

## Day one

| Action | Feature | Route | First build | Check | Frequency | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| adds her first three plants by photo | Add plant | home screen, plus button | build 1 | three plants show on the home screen with names | once | owner words 1 |
| sees which plant needs water today | Today list | root screen | build 1 | the plant due today is at the top, marked due | daily | owner words 1 |
| marks a plant as watered | Watered button | Today list, tap a plant | build 1 | the plant drops off today's list | daily | owner words 1 |
| gets a reminder at 8am | Morning reminder | notification | build 1 | a notification arrives at 8:00 on the device | daily | calendar habit |
| opens a plant's care card | Care card | home screen, tap a plant | build 1 | the card shows light, water and the last watered date | weekly | owner words 1 |

## Install

Put build 1 on the owner's phone after the first PR.
